name: Eagle VLM backbones
summary: The Eagle line studies mixing multiple vision encoders (semantic, segmentation-oriented, high-resolution tiling) inside one VLM, finding complementary encoders substantially improve fine-grained spatial understanding, which is exactly what manipulation needs and what single-encoder VLMs lack. Eagle-family backbones underpin GR00T N1's System 2.
innovation: Mixture-of-vision-encoders design preserving spatial detail alongside semantics.
matters: Backbone choice is a large and under-discussed driver of VLA performance.
limits: General-purpose VLM work whose robot-specific benefit is indirect.
lineage: CLIP-style vision-language pretraining specialized for spatially detailed perception.
